# OM-5 Mark II FILMLOOK presets from the card, OMKit 0.1.0

The film look steps through .ISP presets on the card in one picture mode slot; the developers report it coming back after light sleep.

**Camera:** [OM SYSTEM OM-5 Mark II](../cameras/om5-ii.md) · **Project:** [OMKit](../projects/omkit.md)

**Firmware:** [om5-ii firmware 1.1, build 1100](../firmware/om5-ii-1100.md) · **Mod build:** loader fw1100 (OMKit 0.1.0)

In OMKit 0.1.0 (FILMLOOK 1.12), a film look in one picture mode slot applies .ISP presets read from the card to live view and stills.

**Availability:** published release. **Implementation basis:** reported.

## Supporting observations

- [OM-5 Mark II OMKit loader patch: developers' camera](../evidence/om5-ii-omkit-loader.md) — physical camera; reported pass; partial report; reported hash.

## Limits

- The linked camera report is about the loader; its only film-look item is that the look and preset return after light sleep.
- .ISP presets are this body's colour tables; they are not interchangeable with other projects' look files.
